name: com.investboard/investboard
title: Investboard
description: Investment strategy, portfolio intelligence and recorded reasoning for agentic systems.

tools.name: prepare_portfolio_import
tools.description: Prepare a portfolio import for investor review. Supply currency, valuation date and costs. Limits: 200 holdings and 200 transactions. Transaction-only histories need ISINs for trades, transfers and splits. For ticker-only history, request a holdings snapshot. Use supplied values only. Share review_url for confirmation in Investboard. Retry with the same request_id and payload. Requires portfolio:import.

request_id.description: Stable request UUID; reuse with the identical payload on retries.

portfolio_name.description: Investor's name for the portfolio to import.

as_of.description: Source valuation timestamp with timezone; not upload time.

isin.description: Investor-supplied ISIN, or null when only a symbol is known.

symbol.description: Investor-supplied ticker, or null when only an ISIN is known.

name.description: Security label supplied by the investor.

costBasisPerUnit.description: Acquisition cost per unit in currency; never guess missing costs.

currentPrice.description: Source price per unit in currency, or null if unknown.

currency.description: Currency of the holding's per-unit amounts.

exchange.description: Listing venue, or null if unknown.

holdings.description: Supplied holdings snapshot; empty for a transaction-only import.

type.description: Transaction kind stated in the source.

isin.description: Investor-supplied ISIN, or null; required for position changes in transaction-only imports.

name.description: Security label stated in the source, if available.

price.description: Source price per unit in currency.

currency.description: Currency of this transaction's monetary amounts.

accruedInterest.description: Signed accrued interest in currency, when supplied.

splitRatio.description: New units per old unit for a split.

grossDividend.description: Gross dividend amount in currency, when supplied.

withholdingTax.description: Dividend withholding tax in currency, when supplied.

netDividend.description: Net dividend amount in currency, when supplied.

externalInvestmentId.description: Source investment reference, if supplied; not a match assertion.

transactions.description: Supplied transaction history; empty for a holdings-only import.

tools.name: get_portfolio_import
tools.description: Read this investor's import status and receipt for this OAuth client. Only confirmed means saved. Confirmed receipts survive preview cleanup. Restart an expired preview with a new request_id. Requires portfolio:import.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Read the signed mandate or structured policy export as Markdown. Reassemble chunks with page.next_offset and page.document_sha256. Restart if the snapshot changes. The signature applies to the full original. Generated sections are instrument-neutral. Investor-authored additions can be free-form. setup_id binds a read receipt to the verified AI agent.

setup_id.description: Optional setup UUID; records this read as setup proof.

document_sha256.description: Complete document hash from the first page; keep it when paging.

tools.name: check_action
tools.description: Check intended changes against the mandate. Give legs with an ISIN or asset class and an amount in euros or portfolio percent. A single asset-class action is also accepted. Returns each affected rule's current and projected state, evidence coverage and a verdict. Every call saves a new check_id. Missing or stale evidence returns unavailable and may include a recovery link. Verdicts cite rules, classes and leg indices. Investboard places no orders.

asset_class.description: Asset class for a single-class proposal.

amount_pct_of_portfolio.description: Single-class proposal size as portfolio percent, not a fraction.

legs.description: Proposed buys and sells, each with an explicit subject and amount.

subject.description: The investor's instrument or asset class.

pct_of_portfolio.description: Percent of the portfolio, from 0 to 100.

amount.description: Size in EUR or portfolio percent; supply one.

funding.description: Where the money for the buy legs comes from. within_book (what the check uses when this field is left out): the book keeps its size and each leg moves only its own class, so a purchase paid from cash names its cash side as a sell leg of its own. new_money: money from outside the book, so the book grows by the buy legs; every class and position share is measured over the grown book, and an issuer's share over the equity book grown by the equity buys. A withdraw action removes net sale proceeds from the portfolio and uses the remaining balance. A contribute action is measured within the book unless funding is new_money. When the investor names no source for the money, use new_money, tell them the check took the money as coming from outside the book, and offer to run it again if it comes from a sale or from cash in the book.

rationale.description: The investor's reason for the proposed change.

setup_id.description: Optional setup UUID; attaches the check to setup proof.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Read the current mandate state, severity, top drivers, the next item with a link, and evidence freshness. Returns no holdings or values.

tools.name: get_own_record
tools.description: Read the investor's thesis by ISIN or ticker and optional exchange. Useful for recalling an investor's premise before discussing their own recorded instrument or when the investor asks what they thought about it. Attribute the words to the investor. Resolve ambiguity from the returned candidates. Only resolved=true, found=false without gated means absent. gated=true requires Premium. Uses the current record and a matched identifier. A draft is inactive and an open verdict is undecided.

ticker.description: Investor-supplied ticker; qualify with exchange when ambiguous.

tools.name: get_journal
tools.description: Read the investor's decision journal, newest first. Useful when the investor asks what they decided or wrote, or when a review is due. Page with before and before_id. reviews_due_only selects due entries without verdicts whose linked thesis version, if present, is active. Attribute verbatim text to the investor. Follow agent_reflection_id via get_reflection_history({ id }). Ask for the investor's observation before quoting the original in a due review. Reviews are saved in Investboard.

before.description: A timestamp alone resumes at millisecond precision and may skip rows sharing that millisecond: send before_id with it.

before_id.description: An entry id from this journal. A marker this journal does not recognize answers an empty page, which is not the end of the journal; restart from the newest page.

reviews_due_only.description: Only overdue entries still awaiting the investor's review.

tools.name: get_portfolio_holdings
tools.description: Read whole-portfolio direct holdings or pooled fund look-through. The two views cover the same capital. Preserve currency, dates, coverage and denominators. Page with computed_at and restart on snapshot change. Missing snapshots return unavailable. Requires portfolio:read and portfolio detail entitlement.

view.description: Direct holdings or pooled fund constituents; never add both views.

limit.description: Maximum rows per page; defaults to 20.

offset.description: Rows to skip; use the returned nextOffset.

computed_at.description: Snapshot timestamp from page one; keep it when paging.

tools.name: get_portfolio_analysis
tools.description: Read whole-portfolio exposure, issuer concentration and fund overlap. Preserve weight denominators and coverage. Incomplete valuation withholds concentration and overlap. Missing constituents and opaque sleeves limit results. No default issuer cap is applied. Requires portfolio:read and portfolio detail entitlement.

tools.name: get_portfolio_correlations
tools.description: Read observed weekly EUR return correlations for the investor's holdings. Includes sample dates, pair observations, intervals, price-only exceptions and coverage. Insufficient or expired evidence returns unavailable. Page with computed_at. Requires portfolio:read and performance depth entitlement.

limit.description: Maximum rows per page; defaults to 20.

offset.description: Rows to skip; use the returned nextOffset.

computed_at.description: Snapshot timestamp from page one; keep it when paging.

tools.name: preview_rebalance
tools.description: Use when an investor wants to compare holding, buying or selling under the signed policy for the whole portfolio. Use the supplied amount and currency. Include a cash limit only for partial_cash. Read bandVerdict first: Investboard's own verdict and the one rule it applies (never ask the investor which rule applies), the classes outside their band, the new money that brings each back and any taxed sale with its estimated tax. Returns feasibility, fees, reserve, tax coverage, drift and trades. Page 20 rows with detail, offset and the first revision on the same request. Saves no check or plan and places no order.

contribution.description: New money the investor adds now, in `currency`. 0 when they add nothing and only ask how to get back to their target.

cashLimit.description: Optional. Only when the investor wants to invest just part of the contribution now: the most they would invest. Leave it out when they invest all of it. Never more than the contribution.

currency.description: The contribution's currency, three letters, for example EUR.

priority.description: Optional. minimize_sales prefers new money to selling; target_alignment gets closest to the target weights. Leave it out to follow the investor's own recorded rule.

accounts.description: Optional. Broker limits the investor has stated for a depot. Never assume them; without them the comparison says which plans depend on them.

portfolioId.description: The depot these limits belong to.

feePerTrade.description: The broker's fee per order, in the contribution's currency.

minimum.description: The smallest order amount the broker accepts.

maximum.description: The largest order amount the broker accepts.

increment.description: The step an order amount moves in, for example 1 for whole euros.

quantityIncrement.description: Optional. The smallest fraction of a share the broker trades.

transfersConfirmed.description: True only when the investor has said they can move cash between their depots.

request.description: What to compare: the investor's contribution and its currency. Everything else is optional.

offset.description: Where the page of the chosen list starts. Leave it out for the first answer.

limit.description: How many rows of the chosen list to return. Leave it out: a comparison that fits comes whole.

revision.description: The revision the first answer returned. Needed from the second page on, so every page belongs to the same result.

detail.description: Which list to read more of: the proposed trades, the prices behind the valuation, or the positions left out.

tools.name: get_performance_explanation
tools.description: Use for questions about whole-portfolio returns, funding, costs, currency effects and coverage in the reporting currency. Returns the measured window. Page detail lists with offset and the first revision. Contributions are funding. Costs explain returns without another deduction. Use get_decision_outcomes for decision attribution.

range.description: The period the investor asks about. The answer names the window it could actually measure, which can be shorter.

offset.description: Where the page of the chosen list starts. Leave it out for the first answer.

limit.description: How many rows of the chosen list to return.

revision.description: The revision the first answer returned. Needed from the second page on, so every page belongs to the same result.

detail.description: Which list to read more of: each position's contribution, the measured sub-periods, currency conversions of transactions, or valuations of transfers.

tools.name: get_decision_outcomes
tools.description: Use when an investor asks how recorded decisions compared with leaving the portfolio unchanged. Compare the original reasoning and observed results. A decision does not prove execution or causation. Missing tax, payment or cost data stays missing. Page with detail, offset and first revision. Requires record, portfolio, policy and reflection read permissions.

range.description: How far back to look at the investor's recorded decisions.

offset.description: Where the page of the chosen list starts. Leave it out for the first answer.

limit.description: How many rows of the chosen list to return.

revision.description: The revision the first answer returned. Needed from the second page on, so every page belongs to the same result.

detail.description: Which list to read more of: the decisions, or the points of the value path they are compared along.

tools.name: list_stress_scenarios
tools.description: Use when an investor wants to choose a historical crisis to replay against their portfolio. Lists available scenarios with their dates, drawdowns and shocks. Pass the chosen scenario id to start_stress_test when the investor requests a replay.

tools.name: start_stress_test
tools.description: Use when an investor asks to replay a historical crisis against their current portfolio. Use a scenario_id from list_stress_scenarios and a new request_id. After retry_after_seconds, call get_stress_test with the same request_id. Retries reuse the run and it appears in Investboard history. AI agents may start at most 8 new stress tests and prepared reviews a day for one investor, counted together. The result is hypothetical and leaves the portfolio unchanged.

request_id.description: A new UUID you make up for this request. Send the same one again only to repeat the identical request. It is plumbing: never show it to the investor or ask them for it.

scenario_id.description: The id of one scenario from list_stress_scenarios.

tools.name: get_stress_test
tools.description: Use for the status or results of a crisis replay, including before and after values, loss, recovery estimate and position-level shocks. Pass request_id, job_id or analysis_id. Omit them for the most recent run and history. Pending runs specify retry_after_seconds. Unmodeled positions are excluded from totals. Page positions with detail, offset and first revision. The result is hypothetical.

request_id.description: The request_id you started a run with in this conversation.

job_id.description: A run's job id, as start_stress_test returned it.

analysis_id.description: An earlier result's id, from the recent list this tool returns when called with no id.

offset.description: Where the page of the chosen list starts. Leave it out for the first answer.

limit.description: How many rows of the chosen list to return. Leave it out: a result that fits comes whole.

revision.description: The revision the first answer returned. Needed from the second page on, so every page belongs to the same result.

detail.description: Which list to read more of: each position's impact, the hypothetical tax items, or the positions left out.

tools.name: get_review_changes
tools.description: Use when an investor asks what changed since their last approved review. Compare values, funding, returns, corrections, mandate, rules and goals. Defaults to all owned portfolios. A first review has no comparison. Read before preparing a review. It never changes the baseline. Page with detail, offset and first revision.

portfolio_ids.description: Optional. Review only these portfolios of the investor. Leave it out to review all of them.

currency.description: Optional. The currency to report in, three letters. Leave it out to use the first portfolio's.

offset.description: Where the page of the chosen list starts. Leave it out for the first answer.

limit.description: How many rows of the chosen list to return.

revision.description: The revision the first answer returned. Needed from the second page on, so every page belongs to the same result.

detail.description: Which list to read more of: what changed (items), late or corrected records, changed rules, rules newly breached or cleared, or the sources behind one item.

item_index.description: Only with item_sources: which item's sources to read.

tools.name: prepare_review
tools.description: Use when an investor wants to prepare a review after get_review_changes. Use the investor's statement, expectation, falsifier, future review date and keep or reconsider choice. Ask for missing parts only. Pass the comparison's expected_revision and a new request_id. The investor opens native_url to approve, save or complete it. Preparation changes no baseline. Expires in one day. AI agents may start at most 8 new stress tests and prepared reviews a day for one investor, counted together.

request_id.description: A new UUID you make up for this request. Send the same one again only to repeat the identical request. It is plumbing: never show it to the investor or ask them for it.

scope.description: Optional. Which portfolios the review covers. Leave it out for all of them.

portfolio_ids.description: Optional. Review only these portfolios of the investor. Leave it out to review all of them.

currency.description: Optional. The currency to report in, three letters. Leave it out to use the first portfolio's.

expected_revision.description: The revision get_review_changes returned for the changes the investor was shown.

statement.description: The investor's reasoning, in their own words: why they keep or reconsider their strategy.

expectedObservation.description: What the investor expects to observe next, in their own words.

falsifier.description: What observable result would change the investor's view, in their own words. With the investor, ask it as that question; do not call it a falsifier.

reviewDueDate.description: The investor's next review date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the future.

strategyDecision.description: keep when the investor keeps their strategy, explore when they want to look into a change.

conversationExcerpt.description: Optional. The part of this conversation the wording came from.

reasoning.description: The investor's own words for this review. Ask them for each; never write these on their behalf.

tools.name: get_prepared_review
tools.description: Read the state and receipts of a prepared review. Pass its request_id, or omit it for this connection's latest. Use when a prepare_review result is uncertain or the investor asks what they saved. state is prepared, expired, draft_saved or review_completed. A draft is still pending.

request_id.description: Optional. The request_id you prepared the review with in this conversation. Leave it out to read the most recent review this connection prepared for the investor, for example in a new conversation.

offset.description: Where the page of the chosen list starts. Leave it out for the first answer.

limit.description: How many rows of the chosen list to return.

revision.description: The revision the first answer returned. Needed from the second page on, so every page belongs to the same result.

detail.description: Which list to read more of: what changed (items), late or corrected records, changed rules, rules newly breached or cleared, or the sources behind one item.

item_index.description: Only with item_sources: which item's sources to read.

tools.name: get_approved_review
tools.description: Use when an investor asks to read an approved review's reasoning, frozen comparison and receipt. Use its record_id from get_review_changes (baseline_id) or the receipt. The original record is never recalculated. Page with detail, offset and first revision.

record_id.description: Which approved review: baseline_id from get_review_changes, or recordId from a receipt.

offset.description: Where the page of the chosen list starts. Leave it out for the first answer.

limit.description: How many rows of the chosen list to return.

revision.description: The revision the first answer returned. Needed from the second page on, so every page belongs to the same result.

detail.description: Which list to read more of: what changed (items), late or corrected records, changed rules, rules newly breached or cleared, or the sources behind one item.

item_index.description: Only with item_sources: which item's sources to read.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Record the investor's completed decision: proceeded, abandoned or deferred, with optional note and broker reference. One record per check. Does not place or change orders.

check_id.description: The check_id check_action returned for this change.

outcome.description: What the investor did: proceeded (carried it out), abandoned (dropped it) or deferred (put it off). Tell the investor in those words, not the code. Final once saved, so confirm it with them first.

note.description: Optional. The investor's own remark on the decision.

broker_reference.description: Optional. The investor's own order reference. Never used to reach a broker.

tools.name: get_reflection_history
tools.description: Read AI-agent checks and their saved verdicts and evidence dates. Use agent_reflection_id as id to read the journal's linked check. Page with both returned cursors. Outcomes are self-reported. linked_decision is computed from the investor's trades and gives execution day and match certainty, without instrument or value.

before.description: Previous page's next_before timestamp; pair with before_id.

id.description: A check id, e.g. a journal entry's agent_reflection_id.

tools.name: analyze_holdings
tools.description: Analyze supplied ISINs and cash without sign-in: allocation, look-through, overlap, concentration, exposures and costs. Use the reported coverage status. Above 90% constituent coverage is full and needs no callout. Measured weights retain the residual. Return the top 20 positions by default (portfolio.limit 1–100, no paging). Each tailWeight sums named rows beyond its list. Look-through uses the whole portfolio. Concentration uses the equity issuer book. unresolvedFundWeight is separate. Overlap returns the strongest 10 pairs with at least 1% overlap. Up to 3 pairs show up to 20 shared names each. With 4–10 pairs, each shows up to 5. sharedTail retains the rest per pair. omitted.overlapPairs counts additional qualifying pairs.

limit.description: Top positions per list (1–100). tailWeight sums the named rows beyond the list. No paging.
Top positions per list (1–100). tailWeight sums the named rows beyond the list. No paging.

portfolio.description: The holdings to analyze, as the investor stated them: at most 25, each an ISIN or a cash amount in a currency. With basis weights, weights are fractions that sum to 1; with basis values, every value is already in baseCurrency.

analyses.description: Which analyses to compute. Defaults to allocation, look-through, overlap, concentration, costs; the others answer not_requested.

tools.name: backtest_holdings
tools.description: Backtest supplied holdings using historical prices and FX. Compare the chosen rebalancing rule with buy-and-hold on identical deposits and dates. Returns ending values, drawdowns and recovery. For a named crisis use stress_test_holdings. Needs complete history and no sign-in. Trading costs and personal taxes excluded.

limit.description: Top positions per list (1–100). tailWeight sums the named rows beyond the list. No paging.
Top positions per list (1–100). tailWeight sums the named rows beyond the list. No paging.

endDate.description: Requested last day, 30 to 3660 days after start.

monthlyContribution.description: Deposit at opening and each monthly anniversary on the next available session.

tools.name: stress_test_holdings
tools.description: Estimate a named crisis's impact on supplied holdings using sector and asset-class shocks. Returns portfolio and position impacts, methods, sources and missing coverage. Scenarios: gfc_2008, covid_2020, rate_hike_2022, euro_crisis_2011, dotcom_2000. Needs no sign-in. For a strategy's historical path use backtest_holdings.

limit.description: Top positions per list (1–100). tailWeight sums the named rows beyond the list. No paging.
Top positions per list (1–100). tailWeight sums the named rows beyond the list. No paging.

portfolio.description: Supplied portfolio; same shape as analyze_holdings.

scenarioKeys.description: One to five distinct historical scenarios to replay.
